plugins.description: Let Claude post announcements and briefs to your Discord channels through DISCORDsimple, a multi-tenant remote MCP server operated by CCMS Hosting. List your channels, post text or rich embeds, and read recent history to avoid double-announcing. @everyone and role pings are disabled; message content is not stored.
